text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A new year begins, and Copano Rickey's
classic
year with it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the second day of January. Still on
New Year's
break, I'm taking a stroll by
myself when...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bang!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year, Trainer! It's time for
some
training! Let's get a move on! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
C'mooon. Let's do a little training, at
least. The
earlier you start working, the
better the wind
flows. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We decide to do a quick run around the
track and
then take it easy.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Phew. Yep, even running a little bit
sharpens you
mentally and physically! ♪
Okay...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
May the protection of the Four
Guardians be with
us once more this
year.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The Four Guardians? Oh, well, they're
also known
as the "Four Auspicious
Beasts."
choice_data_list: リッキー、四神ってなんだっけ？
choice_data_list_en: Rickey, what were the Four Gods again?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Basically, in feng shui, they're the four
gods that
watch over each of the
cardinal directions.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The Azure Dragon of the east, the
Vermilion Bird
of the south, the White
Tiger of the west, and the
Black Tortoise
of the north.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And in the center is the Yellow Dragon
that rules
over all of them.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
When I was really little, I had a dream
where I was
drowning, and the Azure
Dragon rescued me!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's why I believe that the Azure
Dragon is my
guardian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a god looking out for her, I'm sure
Copano
Rickey will be able to keep on
running with a
positive attitude this year,
too.
choice_data_list: そうか、『青龍』とつながりが強いのか
そっか、『青龍』とつながりが強いんだね
choice_data_list_en: I see, so you have a strong connection to Seiryu.
I see, you have a strong connection to the Azure Dragon.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Hm... But it is the new year. I'd really like to bask in the good graces of at least one of the other Guardians as well.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes you've gotta get greedy. ♪
So, how
about we go for a little walk?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's go somewhere we can receive the
power of
the Vermilion Bird, White
Tiger, or Black
Tortoise!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After agreeing to her proposal, I begin
to think.
Which of the four Guardians
should we choose,
and what exactly
should we do?
choice_data_list: わかった。じゃあ行ってみようか
choice_data_list_en: Alright. Shall we go check it out, then?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Into the sky with the Vermilion Bird,
huh? If you
want to fly through the sky, I
know just the
place! ☆
choice_data_list_en: Soaring into the sky on the Vermilion Bird!
Take on the hardness of Genbu

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoosh!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey Rickey! Rickey! ☆ Lucky! ☆ Do
you copy?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yep, I copy! But fancy seeing you here,
Maya!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After heading to the airport, we run into
Mayano
Top Gun. She's a runner with
intuition beyond her
years, and she also
loves airplanes.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: What're you doing at the airport, Maya?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I came to check out all the planes
they've got
here! I'm not sure if you
knew this about me, but I
know a
whooole lot about planes!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Do you want to come look at them with
me,
Rickey?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I get it now. The Vermillion bird
must have
shed a feather here, so that it
can absorb the
wisdom that resides in
this location.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You're okay with studying with Maya
today,
right? I think we'll learn a lot!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That one there's a state-of-the-art
passenger
plane! The seats are laid out
in a zigzag pattern
so even more people
can fit on board.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh! And as for that cargo plane over
there...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun has a blast telling us
all about
the different planes, while
Copano Rickey
receives the blessing of
the Vermilion Bird's
wisdom.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The White Tiger, huh. ☆ I think I know
where we
can find one of those.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yep, the zoo! Hey, there it is! It's so
adorable. ♪

text_block_list.name: White Tiger
text_block_list.text: Growwwl...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Maybe when it's calm, it's just like a
house cat.
Let's play!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Rawr, rawr, tiger! Rawr, rawr, grr?

text_block_list.name: White Tiger
text_block_list.text: Rawr!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Rickey! ☆ Lucky! ☆ Very scratchy!

text_block_list.name: White Tiger
text_block_list.text: Rawr, rawr!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After playing with the white tiger to her
heart's
content, Copano Rickey looks
nice and
rejuvenated.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The Black Tortoise's sturdiness? Hm...
Nothing
really comes to mind. Do you
know anywhere we
could go to take on a
challenge?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We soon find ourselves at an
old-fashioned
martial arts dojo.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Rickey... you seek to learn the Kongo
Yaegaki
style's protective arts, yes?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Very well, then. Attack from any angle
you like.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer? What's going on?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki: a martial arts-focused

Umamusume. Her guard must be close to
that of
the Black Tortoise's sturdiness.
choice_data_list_en: Let's start with martial arts fundamentals.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: All right! Here I go! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Time for Rickey's Mega Drill Punch! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smack!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Blows like those I can simply absorb.
However...
you are skilled at reading
your opponent's
energy.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I imagine you will improve quickly. Since
you're
here, would you like to study the
Kongo Yaegaki
style a little more?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'd love to! Learning about a
historic form of
martial arts seems like
it'd help a lot in other
areas too. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through her training with Yaeno Muteki,
Copano
Rickey learns all kinds of new
motions.
